description: This file defines a Java interface `UnpaidChargeDataMapper` utilizing MapStruct to map between `UnpaidChargeData` and its Avro representation `UnpaidChargeDataV1`. It is part of a package related to loan charge serialization within the Fineract project.

classes.name: UnpaidChargeDataMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct interface for mapping `UnpaidChargeData` to its Avro data transfer object `UnpaidChargeDataV1`.

methods.name: map(UnpaidChargeData source)
methods.description: Converts a single `UnpaidChargeData` object into its Avro representation `UnpaidChargeDataV1`.

methods.name: map(List<UnpaidChargeData> source)
methods.description: Converts a list of `UnpaidChargeData` objects into a list of their Avro representations.
